_comment: Optional operator override for model pricing used to estimate spend. Copy this file to pricing.json (repo root, gitignored) and edit — or point CLAUDE_CODE_LOG_PRICING at a file anywhere. Every field is optional: a file with only `opus` under `rates` overrides just that family, leaving the others on the built-in table. Rate arrays are USD per 1M tokens, in order [input, output, cacheWrite, cacheRead]. Families: fable (Fable/Mythos 5), opus (Opus 4.5+ and Opus 5), opus-legacy (Opus 4.0/4.1, Claude 3 Opus), sonnet, haiku. See server/pricing.ts.
